responsibility: This file implements mc’s simplified formatted-output library. It wraps the FormatStrings routines, detects the custom %a specifier and converts nameKey Name operands into C strings, then writes the resulting text to StdOut or an arbitrary FIO file. It is the common utility used by option handling, diagnostics, and driver code when they need lightweight formatted output with compiler symbol names.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file implements mcPrintf’s formatting wrapper, including detection of the custom %a specifier, conversion from Name values to C strings, assembly via Sprintf0..4, and writing to StdOut or a specified file. The sibling mcPrintf.def only declares those routines.
